summary.pl: Techniczny serwer modowany z własną walutą oraz autorskimi modami i skryptami.
summary.en: A modded tech server with a currency, mods and scripts of our own.

mods.name: AE2 JEI Integration
mods.reason: Puts JEI back into AE2's terminals — recipe transfer into the crafting and pattern terminals, and drag-and-drop from the ingredient list. AE2 dropped its own JEI plugin in 1.21: measured, appliedenergistics2-19.2.17.jar carries zero JEI classes and integration modules for curios, emi, igtooltip, itemlists, jade, rei and wthit only. Without this the pack's storage backbone has no recipe transfer at all. Carried as a url because the mod is published on CurseForge and nowhere else

mods.name: LuckPerms
mods.reason: Permissions and the rank ladder. Every 1.21.1 build crashes the first login: they reference net.neoforged.neoforge.capabilities, which NeoForge 21.1 removed. 5.4.149 is the earliest build without that package, and its neoforge.mods.toml declares no minecraft/neoforge version range, so 1.21.1 loads it. Carried as a url because resolveVersion filters on game_versions before applying a version pin, and this build is tagged 1.21.3

Makes the rank visible. Reads the LuckPerms prefix through LuckPermsProvider -> PlayerAdapter -> CachedMetaData.getPrefix and renders it in chat, the tab list and the nameplate from three format strings. It is the only NeoForge 1.21.1 mod measured to do both chat and tab list from LuckPerms: luckperms-chat and lpchatprefix touch chat only, and tab-list does the list but knows nothing of LuckPerms. Uses the same & colour codes and %prefix% placeholder as Styled Chat does in ravenclassic, so the prefixes carry over unchanged. Its /nickname commands are op-2 gated in bytecode

Password authentication. The server runs online-mode=false, so a password is the only thing separating one player's RavenCoin balance and land claims from anybody who types their name — an offline UUID is derived from the nick, so taking the nick takes the account. Version 3.0.0-rc3 over the older 1.0.9 on one measured difference: 1.0.9 puts the password on the wire as a plain STRING_UTF8 field, and an offline-mode connection is not encrypted, while 3.0.0-rc3 digests it client-side first. Both store bcrypt 2Y on the server. The rc jar's minecraft range reads "[1.21, 1.21.1,)" — the trailing comma leaves the upper bound open, so 1.21.1 is accepted, confirmed against Maven's parser and by a clean boot on NeoForge 21.1.248. There is no /login chat fallback: authentication is a client screen, so the client half is required
Land claims and parties. FTB Chunks is not on Modrinth at all; beta is the only 1.21.1 build
Block and container logging with rollback. Ledger is Fabric-only
Ore obfuscation — the server sends fake block data underground. meowanti-xray is Fabric-only
Map editing for builders and staff
World pregeneration — keeps first exploration from lagging
Profiler. Worth having from day one under a core this heavy

Homes, warps, spawn, kits and moderation, replacing Saro's Essentials. Measured in jar 1.0.4-H3: it has the real LuckPerms integration Saro's never had. LuckPermsIntegration resolves permissions through CachedPermissionData.checkPermission as a Tristate, reads prefix and suffix from meta, and getMaxHomeLimit parses the highest home.limit.<n> node a player holds — so the per-rank home ladder ravenclassic runs on is finally possible here. Its own nodes are command.he.<command>. Saro's could only do op-or-everyone per command, with no numeric value anywhere in its config and so no limit to hand out per rank; its entry claimed nothing else on NeoForge 1.21.1 covered this ground, and that was wrong. Also a licence improvement: MIT with published source against All Rights Reserved with none. Two things configured rather than accepted: it starts a server restart task every 360 minutes by default, and its addgroupperm/addgroupprefix commands duplicate LuckPerms, so those nodes go to nobody and LuckPerms stays the single source of truth. It carries no target protection at all — Ban and Mute never ask about rank — which is what kubejs/server_scripts/rank_guard.js is for

mods.name: RavenCoin
mods.reason: The pack's economy: a currency that is also an item, an ATM, player and server shops, and ranks bought through the LuckPerms API. Written for this pack because no published mod combines them. Carried as a url because it is not on Modrinth
